description_en: Performs a manual primary/secondary switchover for an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于RDS实例的手动主备切换
name: SwitchDBInstanceHA

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the secondary instance. You can call DescribeDBInstanceHAConfig to query this value
parameters.help_zh: 备库的唯一标识，通过接口DescribeDBInstanceHAConfig可查询该值
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en:
The switchover method. Valid values:
Yes: A forced switchover is performed.
No: A non-forced switchover is performed.

Default value: No
parameters.help_zh:
切换方式，取值：
Yes：强制
No：非强制

默认值：No
parameters.name: force

parameters.help_en:
The effective period. Valid values:
Immediate: The switchover is executed immediately.
MaintainTime: The switchover is executed during the maintenance window.

Default value: Immediate
parameters.help_zh:
生效时间，取值：
Immediate：立即执行
MaintainTime：可维护时间内执行

默认值：Immediate
parameters.name: effective_time
